verdict.rationale: First-party docs show the full warehouse-native loop. Reverse ETL sources sync data from the warehouse, data lake, or database. Audiences are built on warehouse sources and activated downstream. Profiles lets you declare entities in version-controlled YAML that compiles to warehouse-native SQL. Warehouse activation pipelines reach 200+ SaaS tools without code. Missing for 10: the evidence is only short landing-page taglines rather than in-depth docs on defining SQL models and audiences against existing tables or on sync modes and scheduling, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of reverse ETL or audience activation.
